# 1 Enoch Chapter 105 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Epistle of Enoch

---

**105:1** I and my son will be joined with them forever in the paths of uprightness in their lives; and you shall have peace. Rejoice, children of uprightness. Amen.

**105:2** [Variant text, likely secondary: And now I say to you, sons of men: love knowledge and wisdom in every generation, and walk in the ways of all My creation; for God has set an end for all works, and what is given to your hearts shall be accomplished. And you shall rejoice and have abundance, and love God, and He will keep you; and your heart shall be strengthened and your mouth filled with praise, and you shall praise God. And a parable is given to you from the Holy and Great One.]

---

*SOPHIA notes: LOGOS register adopted. V. 1 closes the Epistle of Enoch with a personal promise: Enoch and his son will walk the paths of righteousness alongside the righteous forever. The 'Amen' is preserved — it marks a liturgical close, unique in the Epistle. PNEUMA's rendering ("My son and I will walk with them forever, side by side") captures the warmth beautifully but reorders the Ge'ez structure. LOGOS order adopted. V. 2's status as secondary is noted; it is preserved in brackets. Divergences logged.*
